notes.title: Last Chickenburg is now on the Eastern Game Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our game is now on the Eastern Game Fest.

Currently we are still making changes on the sandbox map and gameplay functions. We'll have more features and gameplay to share in the future.

Please wishlist if you like our game!

notes.title: Enter the Dragon is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/17d66775517edaaf11797949e9345c89964f9dee.png[/img]

[h3][b]Our livestream as part of Enter the Dragon is about to begin![/b][/h3]

We'll be streaming [b]Last Chickenburg[/b] for one hour over on the Enter the Dragon Steam event page, and we would love for you to join us. 

See you there!
